cards.text: Friend, God's people in Judah have been turning to other gods (Jeremiah 7:18), so God gives His prophet Jeremiah a message for them. It opens with two questions: when people fall, don't they get up again, and when someone turns away, don't they come back?

cards.question: God asks why Jerusalem always turns away. True or false: He says the people refuse to return.
God says the people of Jerusalem are holding on tight to something. What do they cling to?

cards.text: God has listened: they do not speak what is right, and no one repents of his wickedness, asking, 'What have I done?' Nobody hits the brakes, nobody checks the map, NOBODY.

cards.question: Everyone in Jerusalem keeps pursuing his own course. What does God say they're like?

cards.text: Then God points to the sky: the stork knows her appointed seasons, and the turtledove, the swift and the thrush keep their time of migration. Friend, those birds have a better calendar than me, and I spent years in a junk drawer not knowing if it was Tuesday or Christmas.

cards.question: True or false: God says His people know His requirements as well as the stork knows her seasons.

cards.text: The people say, 'We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,' and God asks how they can even say that.

cards.question: The people claim the Law of the LORD is with them, but God says something has produced a deception. What is it?

answers.text: The lying pen of the scribes
The empty words of the elders
The false visions of the diviners

cards.text: God says the wise will be put to shame, dismayed and trapped, and then He asks what wisdom they really have. That's like me bragging I'm the best stamper in the kitchen while every cookie comes out BLURRY.

cards.question: God asks what wisdom the wise really have, since they have rejected the ___ of the LORD.

cards.text: So God says He'll give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners.

cards.question: God says greed for gain has spread among His people. Who is greedy for gain?

answers.text: Everyone from the least to the greatest
Only the rich and the powerful
Only the merchants in the market

cards.text: And God says that from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
Then God says how the prophets and priests treat His people: with very little care. That's like the check-engine light coming on and somebody slapping tape over it. FIXED!

cards.question: The prophets and priests dress the ___ of God's people with very little care, saying ___ when there is none at all.
God asks if the ones saying 'Peace, peace' are ashamed of the abomination they've committed. True or false: they blush with shame over it.

cards.text: So God says they will fall among the fallen. There's that word fall again, friend, and this time, when He punishes them, they will collapse.
Then God says He'll take away their harvest. No grapes on the vine, no figs on the tree, and even the leaf will wither.

cards.question: God says whatever He has given His people will be ___ to them.

cards.text: Then the voice changes: 'Why are we just sitting here?' The speakers say the LORD their God has doomed them, and they call each other to gather together and flee.

cards.question: The voices asking 'Why are we just sitting here?' say they'll flee somewhere and perish there. Where do they say they'll go?
The voices asking 'Why are we just sitting here?' say the LORD has given them poisoned water to drink. True or false: they say it's because they have sinned against the LORD.

cards.text: They hoped for peace and for a time of healing. I know that kind of hope, friend, from all those years holding my breath in the junk drawer every time it opened.

cards.question: The people hoped for peace and a time of healing. What came instead?

cards.text: Then something comes to devour the land and everything in it, the city and everyone who lives there.

cards.question: A sound is heard from Dan, in the far north, and the whole land quakes. What is it?

cards.text: And God gets the last word: He will send snakes among them. Vipers, friend, and they will bite.

cards.question: God says the vipers He sends cannot be ___, and they will bite.
